Transparency & control

Privacy policy

TruthLens India is operated by Pushpraj singh prashant. This policy explains the Android app and this policy website.

Information we process

InformationPurpose and location
Google name, email, profile picture and account identifierFirebase Authentication signs you in and stores your app account. Your profile is displayed in the app. We do not receive your Google password.
Bookmarks, reading-game progress, appearance preferences, policy acknowledgementStored on your device in app preferences. These features do not upload this information to our database.
Optional notification token and platformFirebase Cloud Messaging delivers notifications. Supabase stores the device token when you opt in.
Technical connection information, including IP addressGoogle/Firebase, Supabase, font and image hosts receive connection information when the app connects. This website's hosting provider also processes web requests for hosting and security.
Support messages and information you choose to includeOur support email provider processes requests so the publisher can respond, investigate and verify ownership.

Your choices

The service is for adults 18 and over. Before sign-in, you acknowledge this notice and agree to the terms. We do not request your date of birth, identity document, location, contacts, camera or microphone. Notifications require a separate choice and Android permission. You can disable them in Account → Privacy & account controls.

No advertising, behavioural advertising, or analytics SDK is configured in this release. We do not sell your personal information. Public news content is processed by our backend using AI providers including Groq; the app does not send your authentication profile to the news-analysis model.

Service providers and external links

We use Google Sign-In, Firebase Authentication, Firebase Cloud Messaging and Cloud Firestore, Supabase, and Google Fonts. These providers may process data outside India under their service terms and safeguards. See Firebase privacy information, Google's privacy policy and Supabase's privacy policy. Original publishers and apps to which you share content apply their own policies.

Retention and security

Your app account is retained until deletion. Local bookmarks and progress remain until cleared, the app's data is removed, or you delete your account on that device. Other devices may retain their own local copies. Notification registrations are removed through the app's disable/delete controls; legacy records or records on inaccessible devices can be included in an email deletion request. Operational logs and backups are subject to the configured retention of our service providers and may not disappear immediately with live data. We do not claim that all provider records are erased instantly.

Support correspondence is retained as needed to resolve the request, document its handling and meet applicable legal requirements. You may request its removal; we will explain any lawful retention exception. Connections use HTTPS. No system can guarantee absolute security.

Access, correction, withdrawal and deletion

Email begoneraj@gmail.com to request access, correction, deletion or withdraw your use of the service. We may verify ownership using the registered email; do not send passwords, OTPs or identity documents. See account deletion instructions. If we must retain information for a legal or security reason, we will explain the category and reason when responding.

Children

This release is not intended for people under 18. If you believe a child's information was supplied, contact the publisher so it can be investigated and removed as appropriate. We do not offer a parental-consent flow in this release.

Contact and changes

Publisher and privacy/grievance contact: Pushpraj singh prashant, begoneraj@gmail.com. Material changes will update the policy date and the app's acknowledgement. Contact details and complaint process.
